title: Customer Success Associate (B2B / SaaS / Contractor)
description:
About SleekFlow

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth globally thanks to the support of renowned investors like Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund and Tiger Global. Our mission is to develop the next generation of Conversational AI, empowering customer interactions across all channels—from messaging to voice—and enhancing business workflows and processes.

You will have the opportunity to thrive alongside the company through equity options. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and assume a larger role, we look forward to meeting you!

At SleekFlow, we have developed an all-in-one Omnichannel Conversation AI Suite that drives conversions through conversations. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our AI customer engagement platform, enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.

As we aggressively expand into emerging markets, we seek adventurous, diverse, and passionate individuals to join us on this exciting journey. Join our team and grow your career with SleekFlow!

Mid/ Associate Level

Prior Experience in Saas/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: English & Portuguese, Spanish is a plus

Location: Greater São Paulo Area, Brazil

Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Associate at SleekFlow, you will work closely with our largest customers. Each customer has unique needs and you will act as a trusted business advisor, helping them effectively leverage our product to drive impact in mission-critical areas of their organization and transform the way they engage with customers.

At SleekFlow, Customer Success sits at the nexus of our sales, product, and marketing teams helping to drive company growth and transforming the way the world builds software. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers build with SleekFlow is much more than the sum of its parts. No team knows this better than our Customer Success Team, who act as consultative business partners to our largest customers, serving as a bridge between their needs and our product.

What You'll Do

As a Strategic Customer Success Associate, you’ll be the point-person responsible for a portfolio of our largest strategic customers.

  • Drive adoption, growth, and retention of our customers by building trusted relationships and delivering the maximum value of the product
  • Use touch-points, such as Business Reviews, to learn about their business priorities and guide them on how to best leverage the SleekFlow platform
  • Discover and evangelize new use cases for the customer, helping them to deepen and expand their usage of the product
  • Use your deep SleekFlow product knowledge to onboard and lead new enterprise customers to value
  • Simultaneously manage multiple customers who are at different points on the customer lifecycle
  • Identify opportunities to develop new training materials designed to ensure successful customer onboarding, support business-wide adoption, and deepen SleekFlow proficiency
  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally by engaging in internal product discussions, translating customer usage and feedback into actionable insights

Who You Are

  • You have at least 2 years of direct client management experience, ideally in a Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales role at a B2B technology company
  • You have a track record of delivering value to complex customers with large employee bases
  • You thrive by building long-term relationships and partnering with a range of stakeholders including business, technical, and executive teams
  • You are consultative and are able to navigate the complexities and needs of clients across industry and lifecycle
  • You are a teacher at heart with the ability to distill technical or complex systems into simpler concepts to empower customers
  • You execute with excellence and have a deep track record of creating a significant impact for your customers
  • You are a resourceful and creative problem solver, never losing sight of the “why” behind the “what”

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.

SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)

Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Community Manager Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Marketing e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, executar e otimizar estratégias de conteúdo para redes sociais com foco em engajamento, crescimento de audiência e conversão;
  • Desenvolver calendários editoriais alinhados às campanhas, sazonalidades, tendências de mercado e comportamento do público;
  • Garantir que os conteúdos comuniquem os diferenciais da SuperFrete;
  • Criar e validar testes criativos recorrentes, gerando aprendizados acionáveis;
  • Adaptar linguagem, formato e abordagem para cada plataforma (Instagram, TikTok, etc.);
  • Analisar o desempenho de posts, formatos e campanhas para aperfeiçoar estratégias e gerar relatórios periódicos com insights e recomendações;
  • Atuar como elo entre Social Media, Branding, In-house, Mídia Paga e Influência;
  • Participar de brainstormings e co-criações de campanhas;
  • Apoiar a construção de guidelines visuais e editoriais para creators e parceiros externos;
  • Garantir consistência de tom, narrativa e identidade visual em todos os pontos de contato;
  • Publicar, agendar e adaptar conteúdos para cada plataforma;
  • Gerenciar interações com a comunidade (comentários, DMs, respostas estratégicas);
  • Propor e utilizar ferramentas de IA para otimização de roteiros, edições, cortes e scripts;
  • Buscar referências criativas, tendências, formatos e cases de mercado.

Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência com Mídias sociais;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão e agendamento de redes sociais;
  • Domínio de Meta Business Suite e TikTok Analytics;
  • Habilidade com Excel ou Google Sheets para relatórios e dashboards;
  • Conhecimento avançado em algoritmos, formatos e estratégias de engajamento;
  • Capacidade analítica para leitura de métricas e geração de insights;
  • Conhecimento básico em estratégias de mídia paga para redes sociais;
  • Boa escrita, criatividade e domínio de copywriting.
  • Capacidade de adaptar linguagem para diferentes públicos e plataformas.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com marcas digitais, fintechs e logística;
  • Experiência atuando próxima a times de performance/mídia paga;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de edição de vídeo (CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de social listening (Brandwatch, Mention, etc.);
  • Experiência com influenciadores e criadores externos.

O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

O que oferecemos:

● Meitu Special Deisgn

Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Cloud Engineer (DevOps/SRE) (Colombia, Brazil, Costa Rica)
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

We’re looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong DevOps/SRE experience to join a high-performing engineering team.

Role Overview

This engineer will be responsible for all of the infrastructure and tooling.

In this role, you will support cloud infrastructure and deploy pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform .

You’ll collaborate with senior engineers to automate infrastructure provisioning, manage containerized applications, and maintain CI/CD workflows to ensure reliable, scalable deployments across multi-cloud platforms.

This is an excellent opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation and respond to incidents professionally
  • Maintain and enhance AWS cloud infrastructure using automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines , enabling self-service and agile software development
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to solve complex infrastructure and reliability challenges
  • Continuously improving system performance, reliability, and observability

Required Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Infrastructure roles
  • Experience with AWK and Kubernetes is required.
  • Strong experience with AWS or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres or MySQL)
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to observability tools (DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch)
  • Ability to collaborate with teams working in PST time zone

Nice to Have

  • Programming experience beyond shell scripting (Go, Python, Java, etc.)
  • Experience debugging Kubernetes networking or performance issues
  • Experience with compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS, etc.)
  • UNIX/Linux systems knowledge
  • Computer Science or Engineering degree

title: Gerente de Tesouraria (BPO)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente Financeiro para liderar a área financeira responsável pelo processamento de pagamentos de nossos clientes. Trata‑se de uma função estratégica, com foco em excelência operacional, gestão de riscos, atendimento consultivo e desenvolvimento de uma operação escalável e altamente confiável.

O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir acurácia, compliance, qualidade na execução e relacionamento de alto nível com clientes e stakeholders internos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar e supervisionar toda a operação financeira de contas a pagar, incluindo análise, aprovação e execução de pagamentos para múltiplos clientes.
  • Assegurar cumprimento de prazos, conformidade regulatória e aderência às políticas internas e aos controles financeiros de cada cliente.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para clientes, conduzindo reuniões de alinhamento, apresentações de indicadores e gestão de expectativas.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e aprimorar processos financeiros, buscando eficiência, padronização, mitigação de riscos e escalabilidade.
  • Monitorar e reportar KPIs, SLAs, acurácia de pagamentos, compliance e indicadores de performance operacional.
  • Liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua em conjunto com TI, Operações, Controladoria e outras áreas-chave.
  • Garantir integridade e segurança das operações financeiras, incluindo segregação de funções, controles internos e trilhas de auditoria.
  • Supervisionar conciliações bancárias, fluxo de caixa, parametrizações sistêmicas e integrações com ERPs.
  • Preparar a área para auditorias internas e externas, assegurando documentação adequada, rastreabilidade e respostas técnicas.
  • Liderar, capacitar e desenvolver a equipe, promovendo performance, autonomia e cultura de alta qualidade.
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos de transformação digital, automatização de processos e uso de ferramentas de RPA/IA (quando aplicável).

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Contabilidade. (Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas também podem ser aceitas, conforme política da empresa.)
  • Experiência consolidada como Gerente ou Coordenador Financeiro, preferencialmente em empresas de BPO, CSC, consultorias ou serviços financeiros.
  • Domínio das rotinas de tesouraria, contas a pagar, pagamentos massivos, conciliações bancárias e compliance financeiro.
  • Sólida experiência com gestão de equipes, definindo metas, acompanhando performance e desenvolvendo talentos.
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos clientes, demandas simultâneas e ambientes de alta complexidade operacional.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e vivência com ERPs como SAP, Oracle, Totvs, Protheus, Sankhya, entre outros.
  • Forte habilidade analítica, visão de riscos, foco em resultados e mentalidade de melhoria contínua.
  • Excelente comunicação para interação com clientes, auditorias e diretoria.
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito), para conversas, relatórios e interações internacionais.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Liderança inspiradora e gestão por metas
  • Tomada de decisão e senso de urgência
  • Organização e gestão de prioridades
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e consultiva
  • Pensamento crítico e visão sistêmica
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão mantendo qualidade e controle

title: Engenheiro de Automação de Testes de Infraestrutura
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.

Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções tecnológicas para o segmento de seguros, contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.

Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Remuneração: Dollar | Full-time

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Automação de Testes de Infraestrutura para construir testes end-to-end abrangentes para nossa infraestrutura em AWS e fluxos de CI/CD. O foco do profissional para essa posição será dedicado ao desenho e implementação de automação de testes para a stack de infraestrutura, e não à gestão de sistemas em produção.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar testes end-to-end para fluxos de infraestrutura em múltiplas camadas (Terraform → Helm → CI/CD → Deploy de aplicações)
  • Construir automação de testes para pipelines de CI/CD no GitLab e para deploys de Helm Charts
  • Desenvolver infraestrutura de testes utilizando frameworks como Chainsaw para validação de Kubernetes/Helm
  • Criar frameworks de testes para prevenir infrastructure drift e identificar problemas de deploy antes que cheguem à produção
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time na definição de estratégias de teste para componentes complexos de infraestrutura

Experiências esperadas

  • Experiência em infraestrutura/DevOps, com forte foco em automação de testes
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de teste de infraestrutura (Chainsaw, Terratest, Kitchen-Terraform ou similares)
  • Capacidade de projetar estratégias de teste para sistemas complexos e multicamadas (não apenas testes unitários)
  • Experiência em testar os próprios pipelines de CI/CD (validando a lógica dos pipelines, e não apenas seu uso)
  • Experiência em produção com Kubernetes (preferencialmente AWS EKS) e entendimento de como testar configurações de cluster
  • Forte habilidade em programação voltada à automação de testes (Python, Node.js/TypeScript ou similares)
  • Experiência com Terraform e Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experiência com AWS (EKS, RDS, S3 e serviços relacionados)

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com GitLab CI (ou ambientes de CI semelhantes)
  • Background em QA/Test Engineering aplicado à infraestrutura
  • Experiência com contract testing ou behavior-driven development (BDD) para infraestrutura

Ambiente Técnico

  • AWS (EKS, RDS, S3 e outros serviços core)
  • Terraform/Terramate para gestão de infraestrutura
  • GitLab CI para deploys
  • Helm para configuração de Kubernetes
  • Chainsaw para testes em Kubernetes
  • Aplicações principalmente em Python (Django, FastAPI), além de React/Node.js/TypeScript

Por que essa vaga pode ser ideal pra você?

Ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e espaço para crescimento

Time comprometido com excelência técnica

Cultura de feedback

Autonomia e respeito

title: Junior Client Director
description:
About Us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. We partner with the world’s leading brands, delivering impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, global first-party panel, and world-class team of research experts. We are making investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding. Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn more at

Introduction:

The Junior Client Director is responsible for driving bookings growth through consultative selling, building and expanding strong client relationships, and delivering tailored research and technology solutions that meet client business needs. Acting as a trusted advisor to clients, this role combines commercial ownership with strategic thinking, new business development, and close collaboration with internal teams. The Junior Client Director plays a key role in growing Toluna’s presence within assigned accounts and contributing to broader market growth initiatives.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive bookings growth by achieving and exceeding personal bookings targets (quota) through consultative selling of Toluna’s technology solutions and full-service research offerings.

title: ANALISTA DE MKT INSTITUCIONAL PL.
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Apoiar as diversas demandas existentes na área de Marketing Institucional, com organização e atenção, nas diversas frentes de atuação: Branding (marca, PR, gestão de porta-vozes, eventos e campanhas). Greenfields e Expansões, Arte e Cultura e Responsabilidade Social, além das demandas administrativas da área.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

Atuar como guardião da marca Iguatemi, garantindo sua correta utilização de acordo com os manuais e normas estabelecidos, além de realizar a interface com a assessoria de imprensa para promover uma exposição qualificada da marca nos diversos veículos de comunicação. Isso inclui a organização e acompanhamento de press trips em ações, eventos e empreendimentos, a gestão da agenda de encontros de relacionamento e o acompanhamento de papers, contemplando envio, validação e aprovação. Também é responsável por acompanhar a execução de eventos corporativos, assegurando o cumprimento integral da proposta apresentada, desde a realização de reuniões com fornecedores para elaboração de propostas de criação, prazo e investimento, passando pela apresentação dessas propostas à gerência para alinhamento, até o acompanhamento de todas as etapas operacionais do evento, como mailing, distribuição de convites, logística de transporte, organização de salas para apresentações e mecânica de entrega de brindes. Ao final, elabora relatórios detalhados com os resultados do evento, considerando investimento previsto e realizado, número de participantes, quantidade de brindes distribuídos e comentários gerais.

Além disso, elabora materiais para campanhas institucionais e de conscientização, como Dia Mundial de Conscientização do Autismo, Cruz Vermelha, Outubro Rosa, Campanha do Agasalho, entre outras. Para isso, realiza reuniões de briefing com a área de Comunicação, organiza cronogramas de atividades e propostas orçamentárias, aprova a linha criativa e o orçamento junto à gerência, coordena a finalização e produção dos layouts aprovados, apresenta o material final para validação e consolida relatórios pós-campanha, compilando informações de todos os empreendimentos. Também gerencia agendamentos de reuniões, eventos, encontros de relacionamento e ações, verificando a disponibilidade de todas as partes envolvidas, realizando o agendamento de salas e confirmando a presença dos participantes. Atua ainda na gestão da reserva e entrega de ingressos para projetos culturais, como peças de teatro, palestras, concertos, exposições e eventos, coordenando com fornecedores, gerenciando mailings e garantindo a entrega adequada.

É responsável pela elaboração, acompanhamento e arquivamento de contratos da área, solicitando minutas aos fornecedores, inserindo documentos no CLM, encaminhando e acompanhando ajustes junto ao departamento jurídico, validando as versões finais e organizando o processo de assinatura e arquivamento. O perfil exige forte viés para organização e gestão de rotina, com uso constante de checklists, controle via GEROT, realização de pós-eventos e debriefings, garantindo eficiência, padronização e melhoria contínua dos processos.

Inglês Fluente

Mobilidade para viagens

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer (RST)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior QA Engineer (RST) with 5+ years of experience, who plays a critical role in driving a quality-first, insight-driven approach throughout the software development lifecycle.

This position is part of an experimental initiative to evaluate the effectiveness of Rapid Software Testing (RST) practices within the organization. Your success in this role will be measured by the quality of the insights and risk identification you provide to the team, not by the volume of test artifacts or automation output. This role is expected to improve visibility into product risk, support informed release decisions, and demonstrate the value of Rapid Software Testing in a real-world production environment.

The ideal candidate is a strong tester first—capable of investigating complex systems, adapting testing strategies to context, and clearly communicating risk—while also contributing to test automation using existing frameworks when appropriate. The position emphasizes skilled exploratory testing, critical thinking, and risk analysis to provide meaningful insights into product quality and release confidence. Automation is used intentionally to support testing where it delivers clear value; however, testing skill and judgment are the primary focus of this role, not the tool process.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with a Property Management System, integrates with booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems, and is designed for partner organization .

Responsibilities

  • Lead the organization's adoption of Rapid Software Testing using context-driven testing principles for large-scale, web-based, and SaaS systems
  • Mentor and coach QA Engineers on Rapid Software Testing practices, including exploratory testing, and critical thinking
  • Contribute to the evolution of test design and coverage - share effective investigative techniques that produce previously undiscovered insights through the utilization of heuristics (e.g., SFDPOT, HICCUPPS, RCRCRC), and system modeling techniques
  • Plan and perform functional, E2E, and regression testing with an emphasis on learning and discovery
  • Design and execute exploratory testing sessions to identify critical risks, edge cases, and unexpected system behavior
  • Continuously assess what testing is most valuable based on product context, constraints, and evolving understanding
  • Perform deep investigation of defects to understand root causes and systemic risk, not just surface symptoms
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, and improve testability
  • Act as a quality advocate by surfacing risk early and supporting informed decision-making
  • Participate in design, refinement, and technical discussions to provide testing insight and risk-based feedback
  • Provide clear and concise test summaries that focus on risk, impact, coverage, unknowns, mitigations, and confidence levels rather than pass/fail metrics
  • Evaluate and articulate when automation is appropriate and when exploratory testing provides greater value
  • Collaborate with automation-focused engineers to ensure automated checks complement exploratory testing efforts – contribute automation tests using automation frameworks (Playwright, Karate, etc.) as appropriate, especially for stable repetitive high-risk scenarios

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing for web-based and/or SaaS applications
  • 2+ years of direct experience using the Rapid Software Testing methodology
  • Strong hands-on experience with exploratory testing and context-driven testing approaches, with the ability to assess risk effectively, model system behavior, and adapt testing strategies as understanding evolves
  • Experience communicating test coverage and quality risk without reliance on exhaustive scripted test cases
  • Working knowledge of Playwright, Karate, Selenium, or similar tools sufficient to add or maintain automated checks
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or )
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and how automated checks fit into release workflows
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, backend validation, and SQL for data verification
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
  • Self-directed, curious, and proactive in identifying risks and improvement opportunities
  • Passionate about testing as a skill and discipline, not just tool execution

Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with the hospitality industry, including reservations, bookings, and payment processing

Success in this Role

Success is measured by the quality of insights and risk identification provided to the team, not by the volume of test artifacts or automation output. This role is expected to improve visibility into product risk, support informed release

decisions, and demonstrate the value of Rapid Software Testing in a real-world production environment

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Diferenciais

Vem para a CHC!

title: Gerente de Planejamento Financeiro
description:
Gerente de Planejamento Financeiro

Para o match perfeito acontecer precisa de PESSOAS, com as mais diversas experiências e pontos de vista, para que possamos continuar evoluindo enquanto empresa.

Por isso, aqui na SulAmérica, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas de todas as raças/etnias, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero, gerações, com ou sem deficiência, para todas as nossas vagas. Afinal, as nossas diferenças é o que nos complementam!

#LGBTI+ #PessoasNegras #PcD #50+ #Gerações #PessoasComDeficiência

Como será o seu dia a dia nessa área:

O profissional vai liderar a geração de inteligência financeira por meio de estudos, análises e modelagens econômico-financeiras que suportem decisões estratégicas e a avaliação de iniciativas relevantes do negócio, assegurando visibilidade sobre riscos, retornos e criação de valor.

A posição tem como objetivo qualificar a tomada de decisão da Diretoria e da alta liderança.

Principais responsabilidades:

● Liderar a elaboração de estudos e modelagens econômico-financeiras, assegurando a avaliação estruturada de iniciativas estratégicas e suportando decisões relevantes da Diretoria e da alta liderança.

● Avaliar a viabilidade econômico-financeira de projetos, produtos, parcerias e iniciativas comerciais, assegurando clareza sobre retorno esperado, riscos envolvidos e geração de valor para a companhia.

● Prover visão financeira independente e estruturada para suportar a tomada de decisão executiva, contribuindo para a alocação eficiente de recursos e maximização da rentabilidade.

● Desenvolver análises de cenários e simulações financeiras, permitindo antecipar impactos de decisões estratégicas e suportar a definição de direcionamentos do negócio.

● Suportar a Diretoria e demais lideranças na avaliação de desempenho financeiro e tendências do negócio, contribuindo para o direcionamento estratégico e a sustentabilidade dos resultados.

● Garantir a qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade das análises financeiras apresentadas, assegurando credibilidade e suporte adequado ao processo decisório.

● Atuar como parceiro financeiro das áreas de negócio, suportando a avaliação de iniciativas estratégicas, negociações relevantes e tomada de decisão baseada em valor.

● Identificar riscos e oportunidades que possam impactar os resultados da companhia, contribuindo para ações que preservem ou ampliem a rentabilidade do negócio.

● Liderar e desenvolver a equipe sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando evolução técnica, qualidade das entregas e alinhamento às prioridades estratégicas da companhia.

● Contribuir para a evolução contínua dos modelos, metodologias e processos de análise financeira, elevando o nível de sofisticação e efetividade do suporte à tomada de decisão.

Requisitos necessários para ser Gerente de Planejamento Financeiro na #Sula:

● Superior concluído em Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia (preferencialmente Produção, Industrial ou correlatas), Matemática, Estatística ou Ciências Atuariais. Desejável Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Estratégia ou áreas correlatas.

● Planejamento financeiro e análise econômico-financeira avançada, incluindo avaliação de rentabilidade, análise de resultados e suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica.

● Modelagem financeira e avaliação de viabilidade econômica, incluindo construção de business cases, análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), valor presente líquido (VPL), taxa interna de retorno (TIR) e análise de sensibilidade.

● Conhecimento em valuation e análise de criação de valor, incluindo avaliação econômica de projetos, iniciativas comerciais e decisões estratégicas.

● Contabilidade gerencial e financeira, com sólido entendimento de DRE, balanço patrimonial, fluxo de caixa e seus impactos no desempenho econômico do negócio.

● Visão estratégica e entendimento de dinâmica de negócios, incluindo análise de criação de valor, alocação de recursos e avaliação de iniciativas estratégicas.

● Análise de dados e ferramentas de suporte à decisão, com domínio de Excel avançado e conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (ex.: Power BI ou similares).

● Conhecimento de sistemas corporativos (ERP), com capacidade de extrair, consolidar e analisar informações financeiras.

● Capacidade de estruturar análises e apresentações executivas, traduzindo dados financeiros em recomendações claras para a alta liderança.

● Gestão de equipe, incluindo desenvolvimento técnico, orientação e acompanhamento de desempenho.

● Comunicação e influência organizacional, com capacidade de interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos e áreas funcionais.

Modalidade: Presencial

Local de trabalho: São Paulo – Região da Avenida Paulista.

Contratação: CLT

title: Gerente de Marketing
description:
Descrição da vaga

Ser a melhor solução para empresas que queiram atingir a alta performance através das pessoas, só é possível com um time eficiente, que desafia o convencional e usa seus potenciais em inovação e crescimento de negócios.

Como Gerente de Marketing, você será responsável por liderar e executar a estratégia de marketing da empresa, com foco em aquisição, engajamento e expade clientes SMB. Seu papel será essencial para impulsionar o crescimento da marca e escalar nossas soluções SaaS no mercado nacional.

Você liderará a equipe de marketing em colaboração com as áreas de vendas, produto e customer success para garantir a entrega de campanhas impactantes, baseadas em dados e voltadas para resultados. O sucesso nesta função exigirá uma combinação de habilidades analíticas, criatividade e liderança, além de uma visão estratégica alinhada às metas de crescimento da empresa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar a definição e execução de planos de marketing digital, inbound e campanhas de performance focadas em gerar leads qualificados e aumentar a base de clientes SMB;
  • Identificar e escalar diferentes canais de marketing que gerem maior retorno sobre o investimento (ROI) e estejam alinhados às metas de crescimento da empresa;
  • Fortalecer o posicionamento da marca no mercado, garantindo que a comunicação seja clara, consistente e impactante, com o mercado e internamente;
  • Planejar e supervisionar a produção de conteúdo para diferentes canais (blogs, mídias sociais, email marketing, webinars), visando educar e engajar o público-alvo, além de atrair novos clientes;
  • Coordenar a equipe de marketing e agências terceirizadas, garantindo a entrega de resultados e a execução de campanhas de alta performance;
  • Monitorar e analisar métricas de marketing (CAC, LTV, ROI, conversão de leads, ROAS, CPMQL, etc) para ajustar estratégias e otimizar o desempenho;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de vendas, produto e customer success para garantir alinhamento das iniciativas de crescimento;
  • Definir e controlar o orçamento de marketing, assegurando que os investimentos sejam eficientes e direcionados para ações que gerem o máximo impacto.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Marketing ou posição similar em empresas com ciclos de vendas rápidos (30 a 60 dias), especificamente em mercados B2B e SMB;
  • Ter experiência prática na gestão e ganho de escala em canais de mídia paga / google / meta será diferencial.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em dados, com experiência no uso de ferramentas como Google Analytics, CRM (Hubspot), e plataformas de automação de marketing;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, com capacidade de adaptar mensagens para diferentes públicos;
  • Conhecimento do mercado de HRTech, Produto Saas e das necessidades das PMEs será um diferencial.
  • Ter gerenciado equipes de marketing com diferentes estratégias (orgânico, mídia paga, social, CRM, PMM, etc) de forma simultânea.

Trabalho Remoto

️ Auxílio-Onboarding - R$500 em saldo home office do Ifood Benefícios

description:

◦ Apoiar o PO na validação das entregas realizadas pela equipe de desenvolvimento, garantindo que todas as definições e os critérios de aceite sejam atendidos;

◦ Conduzir tecnicamente as demandas de desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações;

◦ Participar das cerimônias ágeis do time do desenvolvimento, acompanhando as atividades do desenvolvimento;

◦ Definir e/ou validar a arquitetura técnica dos novos desenvolvimentos;

◦ Elaborar apresentações, conduzir treinamentos e participar de reuniões técnicas necessárias durante o ciclo de vida dos produtos.

Requisitos:

title: Gerente de sucesso do cliente
description:
Sobre a Piece

Somos um grupo de marcas de infoproduto e tecnologia que já soma R$15 milhões/ano em receita no portfólio. Temos operação presencial em São José dos Campos e estamos acelerando para atingir R$60 milhões de receita em 2026.

Vemos a convergência dos dois dos mercados mais aquecidos do mundo — IA e Creator Economy. De um lado, o software oferece infraestrutura, tecnologia e receita recorrente, mas carece de distribuição e demanda capital. Do outro, creators/infoprodutores possuem audiência massiva, confiança e comunidades engajadas, geram muito caixa, porém com menor visão de longo prazo e pouco LTV. Nossa tese é unir o melhor desses dois mundos para construir um conglomerado global de empresas na intersecção de infoproduto e tecnologia. Acreditamos que os próximos gigantes da América Latina surgirão dessa convergência.

Nosso momento é de crescimento acelerado, e estamos construindo as bases financeiras que sustentarão esse crescimento. Nosso ambiente é dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a resultados. Valorizamos pessoas que aprendem rápido, questionam o status quo e transformam complexidade em clareza.

O Desafio / O que você fará

Estamos em busca de um Customer Success Leader para garantir que a jornada dos nossos clientes após o fechamento seja impecável, lucrativa e escalável. Não procuramos um "suporte de luxo", mas um líder estratégico, com mentalidade de negócios e foco total em LTV (Lifetime Value) e Churn Zero.

O perfil ideal é de um profissional que equilibra empatia com visão comercial. Você deve ser capaz de traduzir as necessidades dos nossos clientes (creators e empresas de tecnologia) em planos de ação que gerem ROI real. Sua missão é garantir que a promessa feita na venda seja entregue com excelência, transformando clientes em defensores da marca e identificando oportunidades de expansão (upsell e cross-sell) dentro do ecossistema da Piece.

O que você vai Fazer

  • Gestão da Jornada (Onboarding e Ongoing): Liderar a implementação dos novos clientes, garantindo que o "Time to Value" (tempo para o primeiro resultado) seja o menor possível.
  • Foco em Retenção e LTV : Monitorar constantemente a saúde da carteira (Health Score), antecipando riscos de cancelamento e agindo proativamente para garantir a renovação.
  • Expansão de Receita : Identificar momentos de maturidade do cliente para oferecer novas soluções do grupo (upsell/cross-sell), atuando como um braço consultivo e comercial.
  • Voz do Cliente (Feedback Loop): Coletar e estruturar feedbacks dos clientes para orientar os times de Tecnologia e Produto, garantindo que nossas soluções evoluam conforme a demanda do mercado.
  • Liderança e Processos : Estruturar e otimizar os playbooks de atendimento, definindo KPIs claros (NPS, Churn Rate, MRR Retention) e preparando o terreno para a escala do time de CS.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como CS Leader ou Senior CSM em empresas de tecnologia (SaaS) ou agências de alta performance.
  • Domínio de métricas de retenção (Churn, Net Revenue Retention, NPS).
  • Perfil " Hunter " dentro da fazenda: capacidade de enxergar oportunidades de negócio e realizar negociações de expansão.
  • Habilidade de comunicação executiva para lidar com grandes players da Creator Economy e CEOs.
  • Competências comportamentais : Resiliência para lidar com crises, organização extrema para gerenciar múltiplos projetos e obsessão por sucesso do cliente.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em ecossistemas de vendas High Ticket ou IA.
  • Conhecimento técnico em funis de vendas e marketing digital para falar a "língua do cliente".
  • Histórico de implementação de áreas de CS do zero ou em fases de escala acelerada.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets.
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta.
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry.
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience.
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Senior Business Development Manager - Brazil
description:
About Group-IB

Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Singapore, Group-IB is a leading creator of cybersecurity technologies to investigate, prevent, and fight digital crime. Combating cybercrime is in the company’s DNA, shaping its technological capabilities to defend businesses and citizens and support law enforcement operations.

Group-IB’s Digital Crime Resistance Centres (DCRCs) are located in the Middle East, Europe, Central Asia, and Asia-Pacific to help critically analyze and promptly mitigate regional and country-specific threats. These mission-critical units help Group-IB strengthen its contribution to global cybercrime prevention and continually expand its threat-hunting capabilities.

Each of us can help make the world a safer place.

Join us!

The role:

As a Senior Business Development Manager at Group-IB , you will be a key member of our LATAM Sales Team, driving sales strategies, meeting revenue targets and building clients’ relationships. You will lead sales teams, develop sales plans, and ensure customer satisfaction. This role involves prospecting, negotiating deals, and potentially managing a sales team, requiring strong leadership and communication skills.

This role is ideal for a motivated, self-starting sales professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a tangible impact in one of the world’s most dynamic markets

Tasks to solve:

  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Develops and implements sales strategies, manages sales pipelines, and monitors performance to achieve sales goals.
  • Team Leadership: Leads and motivates a sales team, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback.
  • Client Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strong client relationships, identifies new opportunities, and ensures customer satisfaction.
  • Prospecting and Sales Generation: Identifies and targets potential clients, generates leads, and manages the sales process.
  • Negotiation and Deal Closure: Negotiates contracts, closes deals, and ensures profitable sales.
  • Performance Analysis and Reporting: Analyses sales data, identifies trends, and provides performance reports to management.
  • Market Research and Analysis: Monitors market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify new opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works with marketing, product development, and other departments to align strategies and achieve business goals.
  • Admin: Deliver accurate sales forecasting and maintain up-to-date records in the CRM.
  • Trusted Partner: Position Group-IB as a trusted cybersecurity advisor through a consultative sales approach and a deep understanding of client challenges.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of proven experience with sales, mainly in Cybersecurity.
  • Language: Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Role-based in São Paulo.
  • Leadership: Motivating, guiding, and developing a sales team.
  • Communication: Effectively conveying information, building rapport, and negotiating.
  • Strategic Thinking: Developing and implementing effective sales plans.
  • Relationship Building: Building and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Problem-Solving: Addressing challenges and finding solutions to improve sales performance.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with CRM software and other sales tools

Why GROUP-IB?

  • Your happiness is important to us: We want every single team member to be happy.
  • Continuing professional development: At Group-IB, you can choose from various paths to growth: progress as an expert, advance to a management position, try your hand in another department, relocate abroad, or launch a new business area.
  • Group-IB.A team with extensive international expertise: Do you have experience but are looking for exciting challenges? By choosing us, you will be choosing complex tasks and continuously improving your skills in a fast-growing international company .
  • Globally recognized technologies: Group-IB's members are located in 25 countries, and our products and services are sold in 60 countries. What’s more, Gartner, IDC, and Forrester have ranked our technologies among the best in their class. We work with over 450 international partners and about 500 clients .
  • A culture created by each of us: Group-IB’s employees speak many different languages and understand one another. We respect each other's beliefs, share common values, and strive toward the happiness of every employee .
  • Economic stability: Group-IB's sustainable growth helps rapidly develop careers that would take years to progress as far as most other companies.

What else should you know:

  • Flexible schedule: Group-IB does not have fixed working hours. You choose your schedule. We adhere to the principle advocated by Steve Jobs: “We have to work not 12 hours and head. ”Health: If anything goes wrong, don’t worry — we offer health insurance.
  • Certificates and training courses : Group-IB specialists hold over 1,000 professional certificates, including CEH, CISSP, OSCP, GIAC, MCFE, BSI, as well as some rare ones that would be a source of pride for experts in forensics, penetration testing, and reverse engineering worldwide. We have an incentive program that helps employees achieve certifications at the company's expense.
  • Challenges: A wide selection of GIB programs helps you improve soft skills, gain new competencies, and receive monetary rewards.
  • The initiative is rewarded: At Group-IB, you can bring your most daring ideas to life. The company encourages technical blogging, writing articles, building sports teams, and other creative activities.

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Natosafe - Pesquisa de IA Generativa
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Natosafe é pioneira em biometria infantil, comprometidos em preencher a lacuna existente na proteção, segurança e garantia de identidade para as crianças. Durante anos, essa questão crucial tem sido negligenciada, deixando os mais vulneráveis expostos a riscos e sem o reconhecimento adequado. Através da coleta de biometria desde os primeiros momentos de vida, asseguramos que cada criança tenha sua identidade e cidadania protegidas, contribuindo para um futuro mais seguro e inclusivo, onde todas as crianças sejam vistas, cuidadas, respeitadas e tenham pleno acesso aos seus direitos desde o nascimento.

O projeto visa melhorar a qualificação de imagens e a extração de características das impressões digitais, além de permitir o reconhecimento de indivíduos ao longo do tempo, considerando as variações naturais nas características digitais.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Pesquisa da IA Generativa voltada à imagens de impressões digitais de crianças

Principais Atividades:

  • Pesquisa Avançada: Conduzir pesquisas inovadoras em computação quântica aplicadas a sistemas de segurança digital e autenticação biométrica. Explorar novos algoritmos quânticos e suas aplicações práticas na criação de soluções mais robustas e seguras.
  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções: Desenvolver novos modelos de autenticação que utilizem a computação quântica para criar sistemas mais seguros, adaptáveis e imunes a ataques sofisticados.
  • Disseminação do Conhecimento: Participar de conferências e eventos acadêmicos, apresentando descobertas, novas teorias e inovações tecnológicas. Contribuir para a construção de um ecossistema de pesquisa em computação quântica no Brasil e globalmente.
  • Apoio à Implementação de Tecnologias: Auxiliar na transição das descobertas teóricas para a prática, facilitando a implementação de novas tecnologias de segurança digital em ambientes reais, tanto no contexto acadêmico quanto em colaboração com empresas de tecnologia.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Visão Computacional Avançada
  • Processamento de Sinais e Imagens Digitais
  • Aplicação de redes neurais convolucionais (CNNs)
  • Projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação
  • Programação em Python e C++ com uso de bibliotecas como OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch
  • Atuação com frameworks para prototipagem rápida em visão computacional.
  • Inglês Avançado.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Programação Quântica: Proficiência em linguagens de programação voltadas para computação quântica, como Qiskit (IBM) e Cirq (Google), além de Python e outras linguagens tradicionais. A capacidade de programar em ambientes quânticos será fundamental para o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e seguras.

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases

Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.

What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration

Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Finance Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Finance & Operations Manager (Part-Time)

About the Company:

Our client is a fast-growing B2B software company providing enterprises, especially financial institutions, with a platform to accelerate innovation. The platform simplifies the discovery, validation, and scaling of vendors, tools, and data solutions, reducing the time, risk, and cost associated with adopting fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Finance & Operations Manager to work closely with the CFO and take ownership of day-to-day finance and selected operational responsibilities. This is a hands-on, number-two role within the finance function, ideal for someone who enjoys both detailed execution and contributing to strategic initiatives in a scaling environment. This position is part-time and fully remote.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and own the month-end close and bookkeeping processes.

• Consolidate multiple entities into a single, accurate set of accounts (essential requirement).

• Manage day-to-day accounts payable and receivable processes.

• Support the CFO with financial planning, KPI tracking, and preparation of investor materials.

• Maintain and update financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Support international expansion initiatives from a finance and compliance perspective.

• Assist with operational responsibilities, including contributing to SOC 2 and ISO certification processes.

• Identify process improvements across Finance and Operations and implement practical solutions.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

• Proven experience consolidating multiple entities into one set of accounts.

• Strong experience leading month-end close processes and managing bookkeeping.

• Experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments.

• Strong attention to detail with a high level of reliability and diligence.

• Ability to work autonomously and balance multiple priorities effectively.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience maintaining and updating financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Experience with cap table management software and compliance processes.

• Exposure to supporting audit, certification, or regulatory processes (e.g., SOC 2, ISO).

Personality:

• Hands-on and proactive, with a willingness to take ownership.

• Comfortable operating both at a detailed level and in strategic discussions.

• Flexible working style with strong organizational skills.

• Collaborative and adaptable in a scaling business environment.

Software & Tools:

• Accounting and bookkeeping software.

• Financial forecasting and cash flow modeling tools.

• Cap table management software.

• Compliance and certification tracking tools (SOC 2, ISO).

English Level:

C2

Schedule:

Part-Time UK Business Hours

Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the finance function within a high-growth company.

• Supportive and collaborative working environment.

title: Creative Designer
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

We also publish Case Studied, a marketing newsletter with 40,000+ subscribers that breaks down standout campaigns and creative strategies. It’s become a trusted resource for marketers at brands like Shopify, Dr. Squatch, and Magic Spoon—and it’s a core growth engine for Vendry.

The Role:

We’re looking for a Creative Designer to own the visual output across Vendry and Case Studied. This is a hands-on production role—you’ll be responsible for designing the ads that drive our newsletter growth, producing and editing video content, sourcing and managing UGC creators, and designing landing pages and creative assets across the organization.

You’ll work directly with the founder and be the single creative resource for a fast-growing company. That means high ownership, fast feedback loops, and real impact—the ads you design directly drive the pipeline that powers our business.

We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running with Meta ad creative for newsletter growth and expand from there.

Responsibilities:

Ad Creative Production

  • Design 6–8+ static and video ad concepts per month for Meta (Facebook/Instagram) campaigns promoting Case Studied and Vendry.
  • Create ads across proven formats: text-over-video, fake social proof (tweets, DMs, Slack messages), aspirational copy overlays, carousels, and AI-assisted imagery.
  • Iterate on top-performing creatives with fresh hooks, visuals, and B-roll to combat ad fatigue and maintain performance.
  • Stay current on organic social trends (especially TikTok and Instagram) and translate them into paid ad concepts that feel native.

Video & UGC

  • Source, brief, and manage UGC creators—writing scripts, coordinating production, and editing final deliverables.
  • Edit short-form video content for ads, including cuts, text overlays, captions, and sound design.
  • Maintain a roster of vetted creators and continuously identify new talent to keep content fresh.

Landing Pages & Web Design

  • Design and build landing pages for ad campaigns, lead magnets, and conversion funnels (experience with Webflow, Beehiiv, or similar tools preferred).
  • A/B test landing page layouts, headlines, and CTAs to improve conversion rates.

Brand & Organizational Creative

  • Produce creative assets across the company as needed: sales decks, social content, email templates, event materials, and internal documents.
  • Maintain and evolve the visual identity for both Case Studied and Vendry, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint.

Nice to Have: Brand Expansion

  • Contribute to the evolution of the Vendry brand—identifying opportunities to elevate our visual presence, refine our design system, and strengthen brand recognition as we scale.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 3–5 years of experience in creative/graphic design with a strong portfolio of ad creative work.
  • Demonstrated experience designing ads for newsletters, B2B, and/or SaaS companies is a must. We need someone who understands performance creative in these contexts, not just general graphic design.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro or After Effects), and/or Canva Pro.
  • Strong video editing skills—comfortable cutting short-form content, adding text overlays, and producing polished ad-ready video.
  • Experience with UGC—sourcing creators, writing briefs/scripts, and managing production workflows.
  • Understanding of Meta Ads creative best practices: aspect ratios, safe zones, hook strategies, ad fatigue cycles, and format requirements.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal). You’ll collaborate daily with a North American team and need to write ad copy, briefs, and creative rationale clearly.
  • Highly organized and self-directed—able to manage your own production calendar, hit deadlines consistently, and work asynchronously across time zones.

Preferred

  • Experience working with landing page builders (Webflow, Beehiiv, Unbounce, or similar).
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics (CTR, CPL, CVR, CPM) and how creative decisions impact them.
  • Experience at a startup, agency, or in a role where you were the sole/primary designer supporting a growing team.
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills.

Why Join Vendry:

This is a rare opportunity to be the creative engine behind a company that’s growing fast and punches well above its weight. You won’t be buried in a design team making minor tweaks to someone else’s vision—you’ll own the entire creative function, work directly with the founder, and see the direct impact of your work on real business results every single week.

We’re a small, collaborative, and fast-moving team that values quality, initiative, and clear communication. If you’re looking for a role where your creative work directly drives growth and you want the autonomy to shape a brand’s visual identity from the ground up, this is it.

How to Apply

Send your portfolio and a brief note about yourself to . We’re especially interested in seeing Meta ad creative, video work, and any newsletter or B2B/SaaS campaign examples. If you’ve managed UGC production, include those examples too.

We move quickly and review portfolios on a rolling basis—if this sounds like your kind of role, don’t wait.

title: Product Manager
description:
Eisai, a Japanese pharmaceutical company dedicated to Human Health Care (hhc).

POSITION PURPOSE

Product/Brand Management work is focused on driving marketing/branding strategies. Managing the product/brand PnL (budgeting, expenditures, profitability, ROI, etc.) Analyzing potential markets, competitor positioning and customer buying patterns to project demand/profitability for existing and potential products including key product features, requirements, promotion materials, favorable timing for product launch, marketing activities and product training. 

PRINCIPAL RESPONSABILITIES

  • Review and analyze overall market and sales trends. Identify market insights and opportunities and consider both regional and local directions and priorities. 
  • Carry out marketing programs established in accordance with national policies and market conditions.
  • Work with cross-functional teams in devising and implementing brand strategy, activities, and campaigns.
  • Establish an optimized plan through sales forecasting and financial management.
  • Develop promotion and marketing materials to be utilized by sales team.
  • From brand planning, cascade and communicate the programs, activities, and training to drive the brand performance.
  • Resolve issues that may arise during the cascade and present solutions to sales team.
  • Proceed with Plan of Action based on the annual Business Plan.
  • Continuously update the latest market trends and news to closely respond to the market and provide business insight.
  • Provide product training and clear methods to sales team for better understanding of the carrying out the programs and action plans.
  • Regularly analyze brand performance (monthly or quarterly) and identify the opportunities for improvement with the help of sales partners, managers, and key stakeholders. Devise action plans for implementation.
  • Constantly align with Eisai Pharmaceutical Organization and Institutions (government and private) to ensure governance and compliance.
  • Contributes to increasing product value by accompanying sales team to customer visits and executing strategies and advising on programs for related items.
  • Strengthen the capabilities of sales team who will execute marketing programs by providing periodic training.
  • Conduct regular alignment meeting with sales team or partners to ensure effective program execution and offer improvement, tactical activities if necessary.
  • Lead the planning and identifying the other marketing programs like conferences, society support, departmental partnership, and congresses.
  • Collaborate and align with Regional Marketing and Medical team to optimize and maximize alle related activities to boost brand performance.
  • Understand, comply, and translate pharmaceutical guidelines, local laws in marketing strategies and execution.
  • Remain vigilant and be updated on the latest policy, SOP and laws to avoid risk related to promotion.

COMPETENCY ITEMS

Demonstrates hhc and Compliance: hhc (Human Health Care) and Compliance; Integrity

Focuses on Customer and Patients: Customer-Focused; Patient-Centric

Creates Strategies: Strategic Thinking; Insights and Analytical Thinking

Drives Innovation: Entrepreneurship; Innovation Excellence

Drives Execution: Effective Planning; Result-Oriented

Builds Knowledge: Industry Expertise; Self-directed Learning

Coaches and Develops Others: Coaching; Talent Development

Collaborates and Develops Others: Communication; Teamwork

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Education level and/or relevant experience(s):

  • University degree (business, scientific, or economics degree
  • Advanced degree in Life Science and/or MBA is a plus
  • 6-8 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical industry
  • Experience in leading cross-functional team
  • Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence
  • Deep experience in agile ways of working is required.
  • Excellent proficiency in planning and managing resources deployment.
  • Project Management and Brand Management experience
  • Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in previous years.

Knowledge and skills (general and technical):

  • Therapy Area and Market Understanding or Expertise
  • Project Management Skills
  • Excellent Presentation and Communication Skills
  • Proficiency in PnL and Financial Management
  • Negotiation and Influencing Skills
  • Launch Excellence

Other requirements (licenses, certifications, specialized training, physical or mental abilities required):

  • Driver’s license (ability to travel and mobility depending on country nuances or requirement)
  • English proficiency (there is a need to align and communicate with regional team and international stakeholders)
  • Marketing and Brand Management Training, Digital Marketing is a plus.

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.

You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.

Strategic Importance

  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.

Promotion & Trade Effectiveness

  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.

Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy

  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.

Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:

  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk

Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support

  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.

Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.

Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:

  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations

Executive Storytelling & Data Communication

  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.

Proven track record with:

  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks

Capabilities

  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

title: Engenheiro (a) de Segurança de E-mail
description:
Engineering-Focused Role Description

Advanced English

Role Summary:

The Email Security Engineer is responsible for architecting, operating, and continuously enhancing the organization’s enterprise email security ecosystem. This role involves engineering robust controls, performing deep technical analysis, optimizing detection logic, and ensuring secure, reliable mail flow across hybrid cloud and on‑prem environments. The engineer will design, tune, and maintain advanced email security platforms to defend against phishing, BEC, malware, spoofing, and emerging threat vectors while driving ongoing improvements to the organization’s overall security posture.

Core Engineering Responsibilities

Threat Detection & Analysis

• Perform advanced analysis of potentially malicious emails, including full header and metadata inspection, SMTP trace evaluation, message path reconstruction, and forensic investigation of URLs, attachments, and payloads.

• Analyze and classify threats using behavioral indicators, AI‑driven detections, anomaly-based alerts, and threat intelligence feeds.

Platform Engineering & Optimization

• Engineer, configure, and maintain enterprise-grade email security systems (email gateways, cloud email defense platforms, AI/ML filtering engines).

• Develop and continuously refine security policies, detection rules, Safe Link/Safe Attachment controls, impersonation defense logic, and malware/spam filtering heuristics.

• Perform configuration baselining, platform hardening, system health monitoring, and performance optimization.

Email Infrastructure Troubleshooting

• Conduct deep technical troubleshooting of SMTP delivery paths, TLS negotiation failures, DNS‑based routing issues, MIME formatting errors, and cross‑platform mail flow anomalies.

• Manage remediation of domain reputation, allow/block list decisions, and content filtering exceptions.

Security Engineering & Automation

• Assist in automation initiatives for detection enhancement, alert triage, IOC ingestion, and response workflows using SIEM queries, scripts, and integration pipelines.

• Support engineering of integrations between email security platforms, SOAR, SIEM, threat intel tools, and messaging infrastructure.

Email Authentication & Protocol Governance

• Engineer, validate, and enforce email authentication frameworks including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

• Monitor alignment, evaluate authentication failures, and implement policy adjustments to strengthen domain integrity and anti‑spoofing posture.

Threat Hunting & Incident Response

Collaboration & Reporting

• Partner with messaging teams, SOC analysts, threat intelligence, and security engineering groups to resolve complex issues and deliver improvements.
